title: A nestedKey list that a variable source ends early leaves the capture unknown
proves: a nestedKey count equal to the rows of a non-cyclic variable source fills every element, and Build is ready
a literal nestedKey count above the source rows makes Build not ready: the capture is unknown
a count expression above the source rows makes Build not ready in the same way
a parent that reads a file to its end does not prove the short list either
a list over a 3-row source file whose variable has 2 rows ends early in the same way
in that run, the list ends with the last source row and holds no empty element (test_nested_key_source_ends.py)

patch.old:
<generate name="baskets" count="2">
        <key name="basket_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <!-- Each basket reads the fruit file again; the file has 2 rows and is not cyclic. -->
        <nestedKey name="items" type="list" count="2">
patch.new:
<generate name="baskets" source="data/fixtures/fruits.ent.csv" distribution="ordered">
        <key name="basket_id" generator="IncrementGenerator"/>
        <!-- Each basket reads the fruit file again; the file has 2 rows and is not cyclic. -->
        <nestedKey name="items" type="list" count="{3}">
